league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Friday, Aug 21
league_wrap.bottom_line: Joint-practice week added IR-level absences onto already-thin Week 1 pictures. Named jobs and confirmed season-enders matter; exhibition scripts do not. Thin camp info stays Pass.
storylines: Commanders: Tunsil already a long-term OL miss; Newton pec surgery; Allegretti calf setback; White hamstring. Cluster is the Week 1 picture — not a win-total rewrite from one practice.
Texans: Higgins torn ACL, season over (NFL Network / multiple reports). Collins room thins; Dell, Noel, Hutchinson are usage flags, not a minted WR2.
Ravens: Pinter torn patellar tendon, extended miss. Center is Pocic vs Gwyn — do not crown a starter from joints.
Browns: Watson and Sanders still split ones vs Buffalo; Sanders starts Saturday. Wright carted with a lower-leg issue, status unconfirmed. QB1 unset.
Falcons: Penix still out of 11-on-11 after Colts joints; doctor check-in Thursday. Availability, not a grass derby.
Jets: Hall groin, 2–3 weeks, expected Week 1 (Glenn / AP). Allen is the preseason usage note, not a committee crown.
Vikings: Adams season-ending quad. Murray remains the named QB1 after a one-drive debut — Pass on inventing a new lean.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Saturday’s second preseason scripts (CLE/BUF, ATL/IND, WAS/DET) — who owns the ones after joints, and any official IR language. Evaluation tape, not market permission.

team_notes.title: Commanders camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: The Week 1 picture is an injury cluster, not a scheme story. Tunsil and Newton are long-term; Allegretti and White are availability. Pass on dressing this as a win-total lean.
key_points: Tunsil (torn triceps, surgery) remains the OL SoT flag — Coleman has taken LT ones in camp. Do not invent a starter grade from that snap share.
Newton underwent pec surgery Wednesday; significant miss, per team/source confirmation. DL rotation was already missing Settle (Lisfranc ramp).

Allegretti returned then took a minor calf setback (Quinn, Thursday). Good-Jones has been the 11-on-11 center with Daniels. White hamstring from the Miami joint — hamstrings are week-to-week, not a RB1 rewrite.
Mariota (MCL) is out the rest of preseason; Quinn still points to the Sept. 13 opener. Backup math is thin, not a QB controversy.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Official IR language on Newton; whether Allegretti is a full-practice center before Detroit. Flag intel — do not silently publish a new active_run.
team_notes.sot_flag: OL cluster + Newton pec are intel flags. Do not invent LT1/C or the DL rotation from camp prose.

team_notes.title: Texans camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: Higgins is a season-ending ACL. Collins remains the alpha; the WR2 job is an open usage question, not a minted name. Pass.
key_points: Higgins tore an ACL in Tuesday’s Raiders joint (NFL Network / multiple reports). Season over. He was the clear second option behind Collins as a 2025 first-year.
Dell (coming off 2025 knee) and Noel (finger/hamstring camp) are not automatic replacements. Hutchinson is the veteran volume candidate until the club says otherwise.
Mertz already on season-ending ACL IR; Rypien is emergency QB3. That is backup math, not a Stroud story.
team_notes.what_to_watch: First official depth-chart / IR posting for Higgins. Do not promote a WR2 in SoT until the club or packaged depth says so.
team_notes.sot_flag: Higgins season-ending ACL. Do not silently promote a WR2 in SoT.

team_notes.title: Ravens camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: Pinter’s patellar tendon takes him off the center board for an extended stretch. Pocic vs Gwyn is still a competition. Pass on crowning the job.
key_points: Pinter was carted in Wednesday’s Vikings joint; Garafolo reported a torn patellar tendon. Minter (Thursday): extended time, still gathering opinions.
Center was already open after Linderbaum left. Gwyn graded well vs Philadelphia; Pocic is ramping from a December Achilles. Bullock also gets Saturday snaps.
That is an OL SoT watch item. It is not a Week 1 starter declaration.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Who takes the ones Saturday in Minnesota, and whether Minter names a starter before the finale.
team_notes.sot_flag: Pinter extended miss. Center remains a competition — no invented starter.

team_notes.title: Browns camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: QB1 is still unset after a mixed Bills joint. Saturday’s script (Sanders start) is more tape, not a crown. Pass.
key_points: Watson and Sanders split snaps vs Buffalo’s ones Thursday. Bright throws and the usual overthrows — typical August split, not a decision.
Monken’s plan holds: Sanders starts Saturday vs Buffalo; Watson in the third quarter. Same structure as the Chicago split, flipped.
Wright was carted with an apparent lower-leg issue in a 1-on-1. Monken had no update. Do not inventory a DE1 until the club does.
Judkins missed a second practice with something Monken called nagging, not big. Usage flag only.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Who owns the ones after Buffalo, and any official language on Wright. Fano LT1 remains the only clean OL flag from earlier camp.
team_notes.sot_flag: QB1 still unset. Wright lower-leg unconfirmed — wait for club language. Do not invent a starter.

team_notes.title: Falcons camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: Penix still has not taken 11-on-11. Thursday’s doctor call is a clearance check, not a Week 1 naming. Pass.
key_points: Colts joints (Wed–Thu): Penix in individuals and 7-on-7 only. Tagovailoa took the ones. Same availability fog as Monday’s desk.
Penix after Thursday: scheduled doctor check-in; ‘that time is coming real soon’ on contact. Stefanski will not share an acclimation plan until medical clearance.
He will not play Saturday. First 11-on-11 sample — if it comes — is next week’s problem, not Saturday’s box score.
team_notes.what_to_watch: First cleared 11-on-11 period, or multi-day full-team work. Dual-QB availability stays unresolved.
team_notes.sot_flag: Penix still not in 11s. Do not crown Week 1 from rehab language.

team_notes.title: Jets camp — Aug 21

key_points: Glenn Tuesday: tests confirmed a strain, not a tear. Out the rest of preseason; ‘ready for the regular season’ vs Tennessee Sept. 13 (AP / club).
Allen becomes the August usage note. Davis is also working back. Do not write a committee into SoT from two weeks of camp carries.
Smith’s swollen ankle is a separate Week 1 availability watch. Cautious with the ones is not a QB controversy.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Whether Hall is a full-practice back the week of Sept. 8. Flag only if the timeline slips.

team_notes.title: Vikings camp — Aug 21
team_notes.bottom_line: Adams is a season-ending quad. Murray remains the named starter. Pass on inventing a new win-total lean from either fact.
key_points: O’Connell announced Adams’ torn quadriceps after the Giants opener — opposite leg from the 2022 Seattle tear. Veteran add, not a Week 1 identity piece.
Murray is still the named QB1 (Aug. 11). The one-drive Giants sample and Ravens joints do not reopen the job.
Center/OL notes from the Baltimore joint are Ravens-side (Pinter). Minnesota’s own OL picture is not a new SoT rewrite this week.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Safety rotation without Adams; no change to named QB1 unless the club says so.
team_notes.sot_flag: Adams season-ending. Named QB1 (Murray) unchanged. Do not reopen the QB battle in SoT.
